scope: Synthetic Cover Sheet policies, separate from original CPRS runtime

cases.scenario: Two panels and correct selected item details belong to the committed patient
Close/reopen the same item; old and duplicate deliveries are ignored
Same item IDs on different patients cannot accept the old patient's detail
Wrong patient, panel, or item metadata fails closed
A foreign panel owner, foreign row, or duplicate item ID blocks chart commit
Successful empty panel differs from unavailable detail; retry is explicit
Opening selection clears item selection/detail; cancel preserves chart
Activation requires a valid selection on the Cover Sheet and cannot replace an open detail
Accented Unicode case conversion and CJK queries retain exact identity

limits: Core tests and callback smoke are not native-input or assistive-technology validation.
Unicode data-flow tests do not verify IME preedit/candidate/commit behavior.
